title: Apollobuurt + Stadionbuurt (Plan Zuid south: Minerva-, Beethoven-, Diepenbrock-, Bertelmanplein-, Marathon- and Van Tuyllbuurt)
evidence: district survey (BAG + 3DBAG + roof-facts, 2026-11-15): 3,848 pands; 1930-34 alone 2,248, 1925-29 645, 1935-39 451; eaves modes 13 m (677), 10 m (439), 14 m (256); of pands with a 3DBAG rise >= 2.5 m the orthophoto reads slate on 1,646, pantile-red on 455
cell design carried over from the Rivierenbuurt library (the same Plan Zuid casement rows, rijn-1934-flat-three) until a sheet here measures otherwise
five sheets (round 6, artifacts/buurt-generators/apollo-stadion/sheets): Achillesstraat, Herculesstraat, Minervalaan, Quinten Massijsstraat, Sportstraat

wall.evidence: pool of the four brown-brick rows sheeted here (Achillesstraat #352d2a, Herculesstraat #665c57, Minervalaan #56443a, Sportstraat #7b6b5f, each calibrated through the renderer on its sheet), averaged; a row with its own photo draws its own (rowNotes)

families.label: four-storey Plan Zuid block (eaves 10.6-13.6 m): the district's main family

pitched.evidence: red pantile roofs on both sheeted pitched rows (Herculesstraat 2022-03-21, Sportstraat 2022-03-21, hue 49 and 61 in sun), although the orthophoto reads slate on Sportstraat's six members: the slot is not used here. Pitch and dormers as Rivierenbuurt's Biesboschstraat until a sheet here measures them
pitched.roofHexEvidence: the Plan Zuid red pantile measured in overcast light on Biesboschstraat (Rivierenbuurt round 4, #9e5b42); the Apollo photos are sunlit, so only their hue is used

notDrawn.what: a series under the pitched rise (median 3DBAG rise < 2.5 m) draws a flat lid at the series line; its low set-back roof is not drawn
the small-pane toplight over two casements: the painter's transom is one pane
front gardens and their low walls or hedges are not drawn
